title: Ukkā
text: 1 Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || 2 Yo bhikkhave pubbaṇhasamayam ukkhāsatam dānaṃ dadeyya || yo majjhantikasamayam ukkhāsataṃ dānaṃ dadeyya || yo vā sāyaṇhasamayam ukkhāsataṃ dānam dadeyya || yo vā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ antamaso gadduhanamattam pi mettacittam bhāveyya || yo vā majjhantikasamayam antamaso gadduhanamattam pi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya || yo vā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ antamaso gadduhanamattam pi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya || idaṃ tato mahapphalataraṃ || || 3 Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || || Mettā no cetovimutti bhāvitā bhavissati || bahulikatā yānikatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti || || Evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Catutthaṃ || || [page 265] XX. 6. 2] OPAMMA-SAṂYUTTA 265
